<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Kitesurfers luxury</h2><h1 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">BAOBAB SUITE</h1><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Our Baobab Suites have a private terrace with 6m windows facing the lagoon. They are very spacious and fully furnished with private bathroom and separate toilet.&nbsp;The view from your private terrace is absolutely breathtaking!</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Size : 45m2<br>1 big bed : 180cmx200cm</strong><br><strong>1 big sofa bed :&nbsp;160cmx200cm<br>Ensuite bathroom with separate toilet<br>Safe box<br>Desk, cabinet<br>Private Terrasse</strong></p><h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Price -&nbsp;95€</strong></h2><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Price is for 2 guests, <strong>including breakfasts</strong><br>15€ per additional guest<br>Maximum 4 guests</p><h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong><em>FREE ACCESS TO THE GYM!</em></strong></h2>
